text:
We’re looking for a freelance, multi-disciplinary Creative Designer to join our team and support us with a variety of creative projects across graphic design, landing pages, Figma, video editing, and animation .
 We need someone who can work across different types of content rather than specializing in just one area.
 What You’ll Work On

• Design website and landing pages in Figma

• Create social media graphics and marketing creatives 

• Design creatives for organic and paid ads 

• Create visuals for web, apps, and digital campaigns

• Edit short-form videos for social media and marketing

• Create simple animations and motion graphics 

• Turn creative briefs and ideas into polished visual content

• Adapt designs into different formats and platforms

• Work closely with our team on ongoing creative requests

 What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience in graphic design, video editing, and animation 

• Strong Figma skills

• Experience designing landing pages / web interfaces 

• Strong portfolio showcasing social media, digital, and marketing creatives 

• Comfortable with video editing and creating simple animations

• Strong eye for design, typography, composition, and visual storytelling

• Able to work independently and turn around projects quickly

• Good communication and responsiveness

 Tools
 Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut , or similar tools.
 Ideal Candidate
 We’re particularly interested in someone who can do both design and video . The ability to move from a landing page or social media graphic to a video or simple animation without needing to outsource another part of the work is a major plus.
 This is a freelance opportunity with potential for ongoing work. 
 To Apply
 Please send:

• Your portfolio 

• Examples of your landing page/Figma work 

• Examples of social media creatives 

• Examples of video editing and animation 

• Your hourly rate and availability 

 We’re looking for someone who can start as soon as possible .
 Originally posted on Himalayas
